tools.name: search_guidelines
tools.description: Searches the Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA and USDA mortgage guidelines and returns the most relevant verbatim passages. Each passage includes the document, version date, page, a ready-made citation (cite_as), the official source link and a citation URL on zeitro.com. A focused question per call

tools.name: get_document_pages
tools.description: Returns the full text of up to 5 consecutive pages of one agency guideline document (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA or USDA), with the document, version date, a ready-made citation and links. Useful when a passage is cut off or a table continues onto the next page.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists the guideline documents of one agency (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA or USDA): doc_id, title, version date and the agency's official source link.

tools.name: calculate_dti
tools.description: Calculates front-end (housing) and back-end (total) debt-to-income ratios from monthly income and monthly payments, and compares them with the published limits of Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA and USDA, automated and manual underwriting listed separately. Each limit carries its guideline citation

tools.name: calculate_fha_mip
tools.description: Calculates the FHA upfront and annual mortgage insurance premium (rates, dollar amounts, first-year monthly premium and how long the annual premium lasts) from the base loan amount, loan-to-value ratio, term and the case number date, using the HUD rate schedule in force for that date.
